doc: hero_gait_strip.gd (M2-HER-1107, shot field_hero_gait_strip). Rows of Rhen frozen after `frames` frames (at fps) of a move from rest_frames standing: a run start (stick, Input.get_vector convention; +x runs along +X, side-on to the camera), a run stop (run_frames running, then let go) and a turn in place (the facing turned turn_deg, + = left). Each copy simulates sim_gap_m apart from sim_origin (so the capsules never touch), then its body stands at spacing_m in its row, rows row_gap_m apart going away from the camera. start_yaw_deg -90 faces +X. Orthographic camera at camera_at looking at look_at, camera_size_m tall.
